title: Cosmic Mage in Bloom
description: A Black woman with purple afro hair runs forward on a glowing golden path, casting a swirling blue and yellow energy orb from her hand. In the background, another armored figure stands on a concentric magic circle surrounded by vibrant flowers, with a futuristic green city covered in vines and floating crescent moons beneath a starry purple night sky.
prompt: A dynamic scene of a young Black woman with short purple curly hair wearing futuristic armor, running forward on a glowing golden path while casting a swirling blue and yellow magical orb. Behind her another figure stands within a glowing impact circle. The environment is an overgrown futuristic city with green crystalline buildings covered in vines and glowing crescent moons, surrounded by vibrant pink, orange and purple flowers under a starry purple night sky with clouds and floating magical symbols.
